source.title: Feliks Zemdegs wins European Rubik's Cube Championship 2016, in Prague, Czech Republic
source.content:
[Feliks Zemdegs](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/p.php?i=2009ZEMD01) won the [European Rubik's Cube Championship 2016](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Euro2016) with an average of 7.07 seconds. [Philipp Weyer](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/p.php?i=2010WEYE01) finished second (7.88) and [Mats Valk](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/p.php?i=2007VALK01) finished third (8.06).
World records: Feliks Zemdegs 5x5 Cube 49.32 (average), 3x3 one-handed 10.70 (average), 6x6 Cube 1:43.21 (average), 7x7 Cube 2:20.66 (single), 7x7 Cube 2:25.06 (average).  
African records: Conor Cronin Square-1 15.39 (single), Square-1 20.44 (average), Rubik's Clock 8.15 (average), 7x7 Cube 4:37.31 (average).  
Oceanian records: Feliks Zemdegs Megaminx 42.29 (single), Megaminx 44.25 (average), Megaminx 39.04 (single), Megaminx 43.02 (average), 6x6 Cube 1:38.29 (single), Jayden McNeill 3x3 with feet 54.33 (single), 3x3 with feet 59.12 (average), Square-1 9.03 (single).  
European records: Antonie Paterakis 2x2 Cube 1.65 (average), Emanuel Rheinert Square-1 10.97 (average), Mats Valk Rubik's Cube 5.13 (single), Michał Pleskowicz 3x3 one-handed 11.37 (average), Sebastian Weyer 5x5 Cube 57.36 (average).  
North American records: Kevin Hays 5x5 Cube 50.33 (single), 5x5 Cube 54.73 (average), 6x6 Cube 1:45.35 (average).

translation.title: Feliks Zemdegs 在捷克布拉格夺得 2016 年欧洲魔方锦标赛冠军
translation.content:
[Feliks Zemdegs](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/p.php?i=2009ZEMD01)以 7.07 秒的平均成绩夺得 [2016 年欧洲魔方锦标赛](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Euro2016)冠军。[Philipp Weyer](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/p.php?i=2010WEYE01)以 7.88 秒获得亚军，[Mats Valk](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/p.php?i=2007VALK01)以 8.06 秒获得季军。

**世界纪录：**Feliks Zemdegs：五阶平均 49.32、三阶单手平均 10.70、六阶平均 1:43.21、七阶单次 2:20.66、七阶平均 2:25.06。

**非洲纪录：**Conor Cronin：Square-1 单次 15.39、平均 20.44，魔表平均 8.15，七阶平均 4:37.31。

**大洋洲纪录：**Feliks Zemdegs：五魔方单次 42.29、平均 44.25、单次 39.04、平均 43.02，六阶单次 1:38.29；Jayden McNeill：三阶脚拧单次 54.33、平均 59.12，Square-1 单次 9.03。

**欧洲纪录：**Antonie Paterakis：二阶平均 1.65；Emanuel Rheinert：Square-1 平均 10.97；Mats Valk：三阶单次 5.13；Michał Pleskowicz：三阶单手平均 11.37；Sebastian Weyer：五阶平均 57.36。

**北美洲纪录：**Kevin Hays：五阶单次 50.33、平均 54.73，六阶平均 1:45.35。
